# eon_restore_aws_vpcs (Data Source)

Lists AWS VPCs available to a restore account in a region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_aws_vpcs" "example" {
  restore_account_id = "restore-account-id"
  region             = "us-east-1"
}

output "restore_aws_vpcs" {
  value = data.eon_restore_aws_vpcs.example.vpcs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list VPCs in.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.

### Read-Only

- `vpcs` (Attributes List) VPCs available in the region. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vpcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpcs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) AWS VPC ID.
- `name` (String) VPC name, when available.
